title: Empowering Many, Biasing a Few: Generalist Credit Scoring through Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) and Average Odds Difference (AOD) using the AI FAIRNESS 360 framework to compare model predictions on credit and risk assessment tasks between male and female groups.
Calculating Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) and Average Odds Difference (AOD) to compare model predictions between younger and older age groups (divided at age 45) on financial assessment tasks.
Calculating Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) and Average Odds Difference (AOD) to evaluate disparities in model predictions between native and foreign workers in credit scoring datasets.
